units.source_statement: The first recovery aphorism completes its p390 sentence: eighth lord in ascendant or joined to first lord signifies recovery of the theft.
preconditions: Eighth-house lord is actually in first or with lord1.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not interchangeable with lord2 placed in eighth (negative in next clause).

units.source_statement: Lord of second situated in eighth is explicitly said to deny recovery.
preconditions: Second-house lord in eighth.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This is a source contrast with eighth lord in first.

units.source_statement: Saturn, Mars or Dragon Tail is said to signify loss/division of the goods such that not everything is recovered.
preconditions: The exact preceding source scope for these bodies is incomplete; other clauses specify placement.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Retain uncertainty about whether the glyph's house is implied, rather than treat any Saturn as loss.

units.source_statement: Second lord in ascendant is given as a recovery sign.
preconditions: Lord2 in first.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Distinct from first lord in second.

units.source_statement: Ascendant lord in second signifies eventual return after a long search.
preconditions: Lord1 in second.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The text expressly says after long search; don't call it prompt.

units.source_statement: If second house or its lord is hindered, Lilly says not all the missing goods will be found and recovered.
preconditions: Second house or ruler afflicted.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This is partial recovery warning, not denial of all return.

units.source_statement: A nested clause says lord1 and Moon with Sun, tenth lord or Moon-house lord, or seventh lord with first lord/in good aspect, can suggest recovery.
preconditions: Use the text's exact named lords and conjunction/aspect configurations; conditions are alternatives.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The source's coordination is ambiguous; do not convert to mandatory simultaneous joining of every planet.

units.source_statement: The same nested clause unusually mentions seventh lord in combustion, or tenth lord agreeing with Moon-house lord, as part of a probable finding.
preconditions: Maintain the actual lord7 combust alternative or l10/Moon-house-lord agreement.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source is only 'probable' and contains a syntax ambiguity; do not silently remove combust as negative.

units.source_statement: If both Sun and Moon are under the earth, the source says the object cannot be recovered.
preconditions: BOTH luminaries below horizon in the relevant chart.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Separate from passages where Sun/Moon in tenth (above) are positive.

units.source_statement: Sun and Moon together beholding ascendant are said to mean what seems lost cannot actually be lost.
preconditions: Sun WITH Moon and their aspect to first.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This rhetorical claim is not independently verified.

units.source_statement: Moon or ascendant-lord BODY applying to the planet that signifies recovery is said to give the time of recovery.
preconditions: Moon or lord1 makes corporeal application to the previously identified recovery planet.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source relates perfection timing and return, not mere lunar transit.

units.source_statement: When such an application occurs through retrogradation, Lilly predicts sudden recovery.
preconditions: A recovery significator applying by retrogradation.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The direction of application matters; retrograde planets otherwise can indicate delay.

units.source_statement: When such an application is through direction/direct motion, Lilly says the good may be recovered before anyone looks for it.
preconditions: The printed alternative to retrograde application.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Counterintuitive distinction must be retained as authorial reading.

units.source_statement: Moon's term lord applying to the same term is listed as a timing testimony.
preconditions: Term ruler of the Moon and the Moon's term itself.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Applying to a *place* differs from planet-to-planet aspect.

units.source_statement: Moon's domicile ruler applying to its own house is listed as timing testimony.
preconditions: The planet is lord of Moon's house and applies to that house.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Distinct from source Moon-term lord condition.

units.source_statement: Lord of second applying to its own house is a listed timing testimony.
preconditions: Second-house ruler/its domicile specifically.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not simply lord2 in house.

units.source_statement: Any of the just-named Moon-term, Moon-house or second lords applying to the ascendant provides an additional timing indication.
preconditions: An identified one of those rulers applies to first cusp.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No inference from unrelated planet.

units.source_statement: The printed Part-of-Fortune-like symbol is examined for testimony with ascendant lord or Moon; mutual application is a recovery hope.
preconditions: Part of Fortune glyph and aspect to named lord/Moon.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source symbol identification and ancient part algorithm need separate astronomy validation.

units.source_statement: Lord of Part of Fortune applying to ascendant lord, second house, the Part's place or Moon is another sign of hope/timing.
preconditions: Must identify the LORD of Part of Fortune, not just the part's numeric longitude.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This sentence crosses into p392, not an independent observed event.

units.source_statement: Lilly counts degrees between the recovery planet and the angle it first approaches to estimate time of recovery.
preconditions: A preselected recovery significator, specific FIRST angle, and number of degrees.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Unverified time conversion; not elapsed calendar time without an ephemeris.

units.source_statement: Sun and Moon aspecting each other IN ANGLES is said to indicate recovery only after a long delay, trouble and pain.
preconditions: Both lights in angles with aspect to each other.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This qualifies earlier blanket positive Sun/Moon aspect readings.

units.source_statement: In that angular luminary case, a trine between the Sun and Moon is said to make recovery easier.
preconditions: Sun–Moon trine, within the preceding context.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source also says the angle/light setup can indicate more than one thief; do not assume a single person.

units.source_statement: Moon in ascendant together with any Fortune is given as positive recovery testimony.
preconditions: Moon physically in first AND a Fortune with it.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Needs separation from just Moon in first.

units.source_statement: Moon under Sun's rays (sub radiis) or combust in the ascendant is said to mean the missing object will not be recovered.
preconditions: Moon in first AND under beams/combust.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Different from another clause 'if it be' with pain and labour; grammatical antecedent ambiguous.

units.source_statement: One qualification states that, if recovery still occurs under the afflicted Moon scenario, it comes with much pain and labour.
preconditions: A source-positive circumstance despite adverse Moon status.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not force a binary impossibility where the printed 'if it be' permits difficulty.

units.source_statement: Both Sun and Moon in tenth are said to imply sudden recovery.
preconditions: Sun AND Moon in tenth.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Exact source says sudden rather than merely favorable.

units.source_statement: If Sun and Moon are nearer ascendant than any other angle, the author predicts recovery with trouble, anxiety, strife, bloodshed or quarrelling.
preconditions: The two luminaries are nearer first than all other angles.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The adverse outcome is alleged, not evidence of violence.

units.source_statement: Sun in ascendant is given as recovery testimony EXCEPT when ascendant is Libra or Aquarius, where the Sun is called weak.
preconditions: Sun in first, chart ascendant sign; exclude Libra/Aquarius.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not omit two explicit exceptions.

units.source_statement: Moon in ascendant with Jupiter is another recovery claim.
preconditions: Both Moon and Jupiter together in first.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source-specific positive, not generic any Moon aspect.

units.source_statement: A new printed heading 'Of the discovery of the thief, and recovery of the goods' introduces suspected culprit detection as distinct from object restitution.
preconditions: Section follows recovery aphorisms.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not use astrological reading as evidence of criminal guilt or to identify real people.

units.source_statement: Moon in ascendant OR Moon trining ascendant lord is said to locate the thief.
preconditions: Moon physically in first OR trine to first lord.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Different return of goods versus identification of alleged thief.

units.source_statement: Trine between Sun and Moon is another return-of-goods indication in the discovery subsection.
preconditions: Luminaries trine one another.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No independent case.

units.source_statement: Sun and Moon joined to seventh lord or in aspect to him are said to prevent the suspected thief from hiding.
preconditions: Sun and Moon relevant to the seventh lord by conjunction/aspect.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This presupposes a thief and offers no modern guilt proof.

units.source_statement: Lilly says if the lord of the ascendant applies to 'the second', or the lord of the second applies to 'the Ascendant', the goods are recovered. The original objects are not explicitly called the second and first house LORDS, respectively.
preconditions: Original PDF392/printed358 uses 'Lord of the Ascendant apply to the second, or the Lord of the second to the Ascendant'; preserve directional applications without replacing the literal objects.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The phrase may describe contacts with house cusps or planetary rulers; no definite lord1↔lord2 aspect is certified from this clause alone. The next clause separately uses eighth-house lord and second-house lord.

units.source_statement: Application or translation of light between eighth and second lords is another proposed recovery testimony.
preconditions: Lord8 and lord2 with an actual application or intermediary.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not an independent theft case.

units.source_statement: Eighth lord placed in second is also given as positive recovery testimony.
preconditions: Lord8 in house2.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Different from second lord in eighth (negative).

units.source_statement: Moon in second along with a Fortune is source-positive for recovering goods.
preconditions: Moon physically second, Fortune there.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The source next specifies a separate good aspect to Moon's own house or lord.

units.source_statement: Moon in second applying by favourable aspect to its own domicile house or the ruler of the sign where it stands is given as recovery testimony.
preconditions: Moon in second AND specified favorable lunar aspect.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The original phrase might designate a zodiacal house PLACE or its LORD, kept distinct.

units.source_statement: Saturn, Mars or Dragon Tail in second is explicitly described as among chief no-recovery indications.
preconditions: Any of those named adverse bodies in house2.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Other conditions in same paragraph can override a generic positive placement.

units.source_statement: Second lord in eighth OR combust is likewise said to deny recovery.
preconditions: Lord2 in eighth or combust.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Alternative negative conditions, not both necessary.

units.source_statement: Second lord applying by ANY aspect to eighth lord is described here as a no-recovery condition.
preconditions: Lord2 applying to lord8.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This conflicts with preceding recovery claim of eighth/second light translation; preserve as separate source claim.

units.source_statement: The bottom of page392 begins a counter-condition: second lord in exaltation provides great hope of recovery, completed on PDF393.
preconditions: Second-house lord in exaltation; following context continues.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not stop at page392 and omit the following especially-if qualification.
